description: Source code for the LM77 temperature sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, including register definitions, configuration, data handling, trigger support, and device initialization.

methods.name: lm77_write_config
methods.description: Writes configuration byte to LM77 config register via I2C.

methods.name: lm77_read_temp
methods.description: Reads temperature register from LM77 via I2C and converts to host byte order.

methods.name: lm77_write_temp
methods.description: Writes temperature value to specified LM77 register via I2C.

methods.name: lm77_sensor_value_to_temp
methods.description: Converts sensor_value to internal temperature format.

methods.name: lm77_temp_to_sensor_value
methods.description: Converts internal temperature format to sensor_value.

methods.name: lm77_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes such as thresholds.

methods.name: lm77_attr_get
methods.description: Gets sensor attributes such as thresholds.

methods.name: lm77_init
methods.description: Initializes the LM77 device, configures I2C, and sets up trigger support.
